claims.claim: The game experiences performance issues such as stutters, framedrops, and freezes.

citations.review_text:
I shouldn't be having any issues with handling this game on my machine. However, i have experienced horrible framedrops ranging from just a small frameskip all the way to a >5 second freeze. I have tried every single graphics preset and nothing helps. (and from my research it appears i'm not the only one experiencing this)

Also greeting me with an 8GB update right after installing the game was some incredible timing.

Overwatch 2 might be one of the most unpleasant playing experiences I ever had. I have tried countless things, from graphics setting changes to hacky solutions. CPU affinity, messing with my driver settings, changing my cache size. Nothing "fixed" the problem, the closest it got was Shader Cache Size making the first launch horrible, then about 10% more bearable.

If I continued to list things I tried, this review would be longer than it would be needed. I ran the game through a quick CapFrameX capture, and the stuttering chart was actually abyssmal. For anybody interested, I have embedded every change I made into my notes for Overwatch 2, where they can permanently stay :D

All of my gameplay time during this review, has literally all been mindless testing. The game system minimum claimed the game only needed 6 GB of system RAM, yet in-game, it was using more than 9 GB, straining my RAM (which I already cannot afford to buy more of) so badly.

The game worked fine on a gaming laptop that was horribly built, and deserves more scrutinity tham that version of Overwatch did. I pick the game back up a few years later, and it runs like I have a two core.

Please do everybody a favor, and do not sink your time into this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that players have free access to characters from the start.

citations.review_text:
I love the diversity of the characters and the overall polish so much ! Be noted that it is a true free to play too, you have access to every character and that from the get go.

However the amount of grind this game requires both in completing events and the pass is unacceptable for me coupled with of course the usual toxic free to play tactics such as Fomo and what not.

Overwatch does not respect your time or money but aside from that its definitely not a bad game.

I have no idea whose toddler was responsible for balancing this game, but maybe we shouldn't keep the results of the ´bring your kid to work day´ in the final product.

Dps heroes with mobility skills can be outmaneuvered by tanks. Half of the characters have a completely undodgeable instant kill everything on half the map ultimate while the other half has some pathetic bs that is useful in two situations that will never happen.
Some characters are superior in every way to others in the same category, some you see every match while others never appear.
Some get smacked into oblivion if exposed for .1 seconds while others can comfortably outheal the dps output of 5 people.
Standard attacks can be aoe attacks that take half your health or they're so weak you don't even see the healthbar move, or they move so slow you could outrun them with some characters.
The only way you can get a hint of enjoyment is by playing the meta characters.

I think there's supposed to be matchmaking, but I often end up against people that are at least 100 levels above me (♥♥♥♥ you casuals you dont get to have fun youre just entertainment for sweats) and every single game has at least 2 people on some recoil macro / aimbot locked on your head (not the ultimate ability) bs. Slight bonus for not having p2w or unlockable characters

The game is free, so feel free to try it but keep your expectations very, very, very low (if you think your expectations are low enough you should half them again).

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the matchmaking as heavily unbalanced, resulting in lopsided matches and unwinnable games.

citations.review_text:
Would not recommend if you value your mental and sanity.

You see, I'm a casual gamer and I only play quickplay exclusively and had no desire to play competitive. But oh boy do I hate the qp experience of this game.

You either got paired with new players that don't know much about the game yet or with someone who wants to try out heroes that they barely use. Which I'm okay with and understand, because here on Asia server (the server that I'm playing on), the queue time for Vs AI mode is 10 to 30 minutes long (for me at least), so you better off go to qp to try out heroes.

OR you got paired with sweaty high ranked/try hard players that stomped the enemy team of new players and/or casuals. Yes it made the match easy for me, but I just don't get how is it fun when the other team got stomped by an unfair matchmaking system of this game.

So, when I find the match literally aren't winnable or misrable to the enemy team, I left... But guess what?

You can get penalty when you left more than one match of QP. Not to mention, the game still penalized you if you suddenly got kicked out of the server during a match for no reason or when your internet decides it's the best time to pull a prank on you.

The only thing that's keeping me playing this game are some of the unique and iconic (old) heroes that I feel attached to that I couldn't find, play, and experience on any other games that I have. Which what I want people wanting to try this game out to avoid.

But that's on you to decide, but do give it a try if you're really really really really wanted to, it's a free game anyway.

(Sorry if my English feels off, it's not my first language, and yeah I'm writing this cause I'm penalized and I'm bored)

Worst matchmaking you'll ever see in any game. It's a forced almost 50/50 overall win rate, and most of your games throughout the day will be nothing but heavy losses because you'll be placed on a braindead team against very high ranked teams. Every now and then it will throw at you the casino-style addiction where you get a really good win or two to keep you playing, followed by tons of horrible games. Unless you have the patience to deal with it while being aware that the fun you'll encounter is minimal, or you are a gambling addict and itching for the same experience from a casino that will still cost you money, only then should you come anywhere near this game.

This is also one of those games that makes you feel like the devs have never played their own games. Unnecessary and unfair changes are always being implemented, bad characters being made worse and overpowered ones being made better, or changes that nobody asked for. If they see something is being complained about, they will make it worse. But if they see something is being enjoyed, they will also make it worse. Or they'll completely ignore any and all issues that they know they can fix to make the game more enjoyable, and actually fun.

I do not recommend putting significant time or money into this game and if you've never played it before please do not start now.

- Activision Blizzard has demonstrated biblical levels of greed in the monetization of this game. I'll use only one example, A one hundred dollar cosmetic pack.
- Overwatch (formerly Overwatch 2) has delivered on effectively zero of its promises over the last several years including any and all story content

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the developers replaced standard core playlists with experimental or unrequested game modes.

citations.review_text: Overwatch wanted to trial a new type of 6v6 quickplay. So, rather than just add it in as an option, or temporarily replace the existing 6v6 quickplay. They instead got rid of the 5v5 quickplay, their most popular gamemode by far. Game is basically unplayable until its reverted unless you wanna play a weird game mode or do comp.

Forcing unwanted 6v6 in unranked and taking away your core gamemode from your player base might sound like a good idea if the devs were violently slammed on their heads as babies. But to everyone else, it just kinda sucks. Nobody is asking for this dumb experiment.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the developers discontinued support or updates for the Stadium game mode.

citations.review_text:
Sadly just had to uninstall this game.

Overwatch has always had it's problems, horrible balancing, & bad matchmaking, however Overwatch Stadium brought something new and refreshing to the game.

It was just announced they are no longer updating or support Stadium, the only game mode I play, so no point in me having this game any longer.

> Add a unique new game mode that combines a hero shooter with a MOBA, without the need to farm mobs or creeps.
> Take too long to add more heroes to this game mode.
> Act surprised when people stop playing it.

Screw you, Blizzard. Stadium was a great addition and everything I wanted. And now you’ve basically put it into maintenance mode.

(Soon to) Rest in peace: Blossom Reaper and Blink Juno. I had the most fun playing you.

Constant bad decisions from Blizzard are honestly what really makes this game feel unfun or redundant to play. As of right now the only quickplay option is 6v6, and I very much dislike 6v6. I know it's temporary, but having to deal with this after learning stadium is being discontinued has made the game practically unplayable for me.
Blizzard has a problem with releasing half-baked game modes and giving up on them too quick rather than committing and making them more enjoyable for players. We were supposed to get a story mode PvE but that never happened. Hero mastery was fun even if it wasn't a main game mode, and I am still upset about that being removed. Stadium was flawed, but overall a great addition to the game and I knew so many people who ONLY played Overwatch for stadium. It's disappointing but not surprising that instead of working to improve stadium and add more heroes, Blizzard is simply abandoning it.
This current "hacked" 1-3-2 6v6 event has made the game unplayable for me. There is no 5v5 quickplay at the moment, and even if I know it's coming back it is upsetting knowing I have to wait until next week just to play this game. 
Blizzard needs to start listening to their player base and put more effort into making this game enjoyable again.

It's disappointing but not surprising that instead of working to improve stadium and add more heroes, Blizzard is simply abandoning it.
This current "hacked" 1-3-2 6v6 event has made the game unplayable for me. There is no 5v5 quickplay at the moment, and even if I know it's coming back it is upsetting knowing I have to wait until next week just to play this game. 
Blizzard needs to start listening to their player base and put more effort into making this game enjoyable again.
they released a new mode and plastered it all over 5v5 so nobody can play 5v5. the mode sucks. overwatch is balanced for 5v5. keep it that way or ill just go back to rivals

citations.review_text: The Absoulete WORST game devs in all of human history, I have been wrongfully banned and I quite literally have evidence and instead of helping me review my case Blizzard decides to use their ♥♥♥♥♥♥ AI customer service to repeat they same things over and over again and lets talk more about Blizzards obsession with AI, like their ♥♥♥♥♥♥ ban system like cmon instead of focusing on things that matter like smurfs and hacker which are so common in every match they ban people who said the smallest things and snowflakes that cry about it mass report that player and they get banned. And not to even mention the issues with the anniversary event, which I might add is the WORST 10 year event I have EVER seen like a huge milestone and players get RECOLOURS of base skins and a few other skins, and the whole drama with ultra skins. Like blizzard is quite literally the most money hungry-no effort multi billionair company ever. And what kind of game perma bans their paying customers that are helping keep your dogwater game afloat, hundreds of dollars and hours gone because Blizzards ♥♥♥♥♥♥ AI ban system and CS, actually get a grip and make this right.

Would not recommend if you value your mental and sanity.

You see, I'm a casual gamer and I only play quickplay exclusively and had no desire to play competitive. But oh boy do I hate the qp experience of this game.

You either got paired with new players that don't know much about the game yet or with someone who wants to try out heroes that they barely use. Which I'm okay with and understand, because here on Asia server (the server that I'm playing on), the queue time for Vs AI mode is 10 to 30 minutes long (for me at least), so you better off go to qp to try out heroes.

OR you got paired with sweaty high ranked/try hard players that stomped the enemy team of new players and/or casuals. Yes it made the match easy for me, but I just don't get how is it fun when the other team got stomped by an unfair matchmaking system of this game.

So, when I find the match literally aren't winnable or misrable to the enemy team, I left... But guess what?

You can get penalty when you left more than one match of QP. Not to mention, the game still penalized you if you suddenly got kicked out of the server during a match for no reason or when your internet decides it's the best time to pull a prank on you.

The only thing that's keeping me playing this game are some of the unique and iconic (old) heroes that I feel attached to that I couldn't find, play, and experience on any other games that I have. Which what I want people wanting to try this game out to avoid.

But that's on you to decide, but do give it a try if you're really really really really wanted to, it's a free game anyway.
